evidence: Checked agentgen.CodexInstructions (readMultiline/skipBasic) against the triple-quote escaping of tomlMultiline. The quote-run handling (runs of 3 to 5 close the string, shorter runs are kept) is consistent with the round-trip and refusal tests in the diff. I did not run those tests.

Checked codexexec.Review. The codex arguments are `exec --sandbox read-only --ephemeral --ignore-user-config --output-last-message`. The scratch directory is removed with defer. The deadline comes from a context timeout. Every failure after the instructions are read wraps app.ErrReviewerDidNotAnswer and carries stderr bounded to 2000 bytes. The reply file read is size-limited.
Confirmed in the worktree that execrunner.Runner has OutputStdin with the same signature the codexexec Runner interface requires.

Checked the test guard. piguard now installs a refusing `codex` script next to `pi`, and CheckTestSources flags exec.Command and exec.CommandContext calls that start `codex`. codexexec_test uses a fake runner only, so no test starts the real codex.
The spec file is over 760 KB and its lines are too long to read through Grep. I only confirmed that the codex flag names appear in it (line 54). I did not read the S9(b) acceptance text itself.
